Floating Ankles Bind.name: Floating Ankles Bind
Floating Ankles Bind.description: The user touches one opponent with all five fingertip pads and pushes them just above the floor, denying firm footing until release. The user can secure their wrists with a carried restraint while they drift. This is not paralysis: the target can still attack, use a Quirk or pull themselves to a nearby handhold, so the user must stay outside their reach. Strain: moderate.
